card.name: Courage and exposure-therapy words
card.fires_on: Words for bravery such as courage, bravery and adventurous, and the word exposure in exposure and response prevention therapy. Also fires on a few scattered pieces of other words.

modes.label: Courage words
modes.description: Nouns or adjectives for bravery or daring, often in a list of virtues.
modes.example: had the wisdom or the<< courage>> to challenge the status quo

modes.label: Exposure therapy
modes.description: The word exposure, or its first part, in exposure and response prevention therapy.

modes.label: Other scattered cases
modes.description: Odd word pieces, such as the end of a Hebrew name or the word Binding in a religious phrase.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like threshold, hub and daring or endurance terms, mostly Chinese, and away from unrelated words.
